youtube.title: Five Navy Bombers Vanished. So Did the Rescue Plane. | Flight 19
youtube.description:
On 5 December 1945, Flight 19, five TBM Avenger torpedo bombers with 14 men led by Lt. Charles Taylor, took off from NAS Fort Lauderdale. Taylor's compasses failed and he believed he was over the Florida Keys; the flight headed out over open sea and was never seen again. A PBM Mariner rescue plane with 13 men was lost too. No bodies or wreckage were found. The Navy first blamed Taylor's navigation, then amended the verdict to "cause unknown."

📂 Case File #020: Flight 19

Sources: MigFlug, "Flight 19: The Squadron That Never Came Home"; Project Airframe, "Flight 19".
Images: US Navy photographs of the same aircraft types (public domain, Wikimedia Commons).
Narration voice: AI.
